author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
DOOM: The Dark Ages | Hugo Martin's Game Director Playthrough - Ch. 21 BajookieMaster's Ripatorium 2.0 setup Challenge of Bajookie and then plays some Witchfire!

Join us as DOOM: The Dark Ages' Game Director Hugo Martin does his first playthrough of Spectral Slayer's Combat Encounter setup and then some Witchfire.

Here's BajookieMaster's Ripatorium 2.0 Combat Setup: Challenge of Bajookie!
Recommended arena: City of Ry'uul
Recommended track: Into the Void
Time limit: 10 minutes
No respawns

For more information on all things DOOM: The Dark Ages and id Software, follow these channels and join the Slayers Club.  

Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/doom.com
Twitter: https://x.com/DOOM/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/doom/ 
Threads: https://www.threads.net/@doom
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DOOM
Website: https://doom.bethesda.net/
Slayers Club: https://slayersclub.bethesda.net/

ESRB RATING: Mature for Blood and Gore and Intense Violence
title: Slayers Club Live | DOOM: The Dark Ages | w/ Hugo Martin - Ch. 21 Challenge of Bajookie + Witchfire!
